thought.text: Client loads! But it needs to connect to game server. Let me check client config:

reasoning_content: arelorian.de is serving the client correctly! The HTML loads with the game client. Now I need to configure the game to connect to the server. Let me check if the client is configured to connect to the right server endpoint.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Check client config for server URL
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("grep -r 'WS_URL\\|API_URL\\|localhost:3000\\|arelorian' /opt/areloria/client --include='*.ts' | head -10")
print("Config:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
